title: Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet

lines.text: Your head is older than your feet.
lines.delivery: Calm and certain, like letting someone in on a secret. Hint of a smile. Land 'feet' with a clean downward finish.

lines.text: Up there, time really runs faster.
lines.delivery: Lift the pitch slightly on 'Up there' as if pointing upward. Lean on 'really'.

lines.text: Einstein predicted it: gravity slows time down.
lines.delivery: Authoritative, unhurried. Tiny beat after the colon.

lines.text: The closer you are to Earth, the slower your clock ticks.
lines.delivery: Two balanced halves. Ease off the tempo on 'the slower your clock ticks'.
Shift into investigator mode: crisp, a little faster.

lines.text: They lifted an atomic clock just {33|thirty-three} centimeters...
lines.delivery: Slow down on 'just thirty-three centimeters' so the smallness registers. Suspend the pitch: the sentence is not finished.
Direct and conversational. Lean toward the mic.

lines.text: Up in orbit, {GPS|GPS} clocks gain {38|thirty-eight} millionths of a second, every day.
lines.delivery: Steady pace. Give 'thirty-eight millionths' weight, then a light touch on 'every day'.

lines.text: Light travels {11|eleven} kilometers in that time.
lines.delivery: This is the turn: tiny becomes huge. Punch 'eleven kilometers'.

lines.text: So every satellite is built to correct for Einstein.
lines.delivery: Satisfied resolution. Clean ending; music swells after.
Lower and slower. Ominous, almost a whisper on 'down'.

lines.text: Deep in the gravity well, the center of the Earth is about two and a half years younger than its surface.
lines.delivery: The big reveal. Build gently through 'deep in the gravity well', then slow right down on 'two and a half years younger'. Let it land.
Soft and personal, slight upward lilt. Talking to one person.

lines.text: Over a lifetime, your head gains a few hundred billionths of a second.
lines.delivery: Warm, a little playful. Savor 'a few hundred billionths'.
Almost under your breath, with a smile.
Lean in and trail off. Keep the pitch suspended, no downward resolution: the video loops straight into 'Your head is older than your feet.'
